Payfare’s financial technology platform is providing financial inclusion and empowerment to millions of next-generation workers around the globe with a full-service business mobile bank account and debit card with instant access to their earnings and relevant cash-back rewards. Payfare was founded in 2015 by fintech entrepreneurs and a senior management team with unparalleled experience in the banking, payment card and financial technology sectors. Payfare is backed by major investors and financial institutions around the world. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Some of the world’s largest on-demand economy platforms including Uber, Lyft, Walmart and DoorDash trust Payfare to pay their workers. Accounts are subject to eligibility, terms, limits and fees. Banking services are provided by bank partners.
candidates.rationale: Payfare is a fintech/payments provider for gig workers, not a super-app operating the same multi-service consumer platform model as Grab.

candidates.name: Almad Group
candidates.description: ALMAD Group (“the group”) is dedicated to harnessing tomorrow’s opportunities across nine transformative paradigms. Founded by Adrian Cheng, the group’s forward-looking portfolio strategically focuses on the digital space and emerging markets, including Mainland China, ASEAN countries, the Middle East and beyond, along the following three directions: 1. Investing in the transformative industries of culture, entertainment, sports, media, healthcare, commercial management and cultural tourism in selected emerging markets 2. Breaking boundaries in digital and virtual assets, with a forward-looking strategy to explore investments in new possibilities 3. Globalizing K11 by AC cultural ecosystem with new cultural commerce opportunities across regions in visionary retail, experiential innovation and more.
candidates.rationale: Investment holding company and cultural-commerce group, not a Southeast Asian super-app, platform, or comparable operating business.

candidates.name: GCash
candidates.description: Mynt is the first and only duacorn in the Philippines. It's a leader in mobile financial services focused on accelerating financial inclusion through mobile money, financial services, and technology. Mynt operates two fintech companies: GXI, the mobile wallet operator of GCash — the #1 Finance App in the Philippines, and Fuse Lending, a tech-based lending company that gives Filipinos access to microloans and business loans. Mynt, through its fintech operations, is a staunch supporter of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly UN SDGs 5,8,10, and 13, which focus on safety & security, financial inclusion, diversity, equity, and inclusion as well as taking urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts, respectively.
candidates.rationale: Different scope: GCash is a Philippine mobile wallet/fintech, while Grab is a broader Southeast Asian super-app with transport and delivery.

candidates.name: Kangaroo Cargo
candidates.description: Kangaroo Cargo is a leading E-commerce Fulfilment Company in India. We are tech-enabled logistics platform that connects merchants, consumers, and supply chain
candidates.rationale: Kangaroo Cargo is a logistics/fulfillment provider, not a super-app or financial services platform like Grab.

candidates.name: Pay by Bank app
candidates.description: Pay by Bank app is a new online checkout option, powered by Mastercard. It’s safe, simple, speedy, and uses bank security technology, to make payments directly from mobile bank apps. Security is taken care of by the bank. Consumers click the Pay by Bank app button at checkout to pay with the security of their trusted bank. Pay by Bank app is being introduced to banks and retailers for it to become a universal system. With digital tokenisation and banking security at the heart, Pay by Bank app takes payment systems to the next level of simplicity, security and speed. Pay by Bank app: Your bank. Your choice. Your control.
candidates.rationale: Payment product/checkout service from Mastercard, not a peer super-app like Grab.

candidates.name: Dhaweeye
candidates.description: Dhaweeye is a ride-hailing E-service that connects riders to drivers, offer different kinds of service deliveries. It`s accessible many cities in the horn of Africa.
candidates.rationale: Ride-hailing/delivery platform with similar super-app mobility model; comparable customer type despite smaller regional scale.

candidates.name: Vivas
candidates.description: VIVAS is a leading technology solution and service provider, specializing in three strategic fields, including research and development of state-of-the-art business solutions, cooperation in delivering world-class technology to regional market, and provision of diversified telecommunication and entertainment services. Combining comprehensive business analysis and years of knowledge and experience in pioneering technologies, VIVAS’s objective is to fully understand our customers’ businesses and to deliver significant added value to them by developing solutions that dramatically reduce their investment in human resources, time and effort so as to enhance their competitive advantages in today’s technology era. Originated from IP Excellence Center under Alcatel Network System Vietnam (ANSV) - a Joint venture between VNPT group and Alcatel-Lucent group since 1993, VIVAS inherited 18 years of expertise in the field of telecommunication technology. Officially established in July 2011, since then, VIVAS has been delivering innovative IT and telecommunications solutions and services that enable organizations to leverage their technology, communications and people as well as contribute to the creation of a better connected society. INNOVATIVE, PASSIONATE, DIVERSIFIED - That’s how we are. Strategic development pillars/ Business fields - Innovative solutions R&D - Global partners cooperation - Diversified services offering
candidates.rationale: Telecommunications/IT services provider, not a super-app or comparable consumer-platform company like Grab.

candidates.name: Little App Kenya
candidates.description: Little is a Pan-African super App providing everyday services such as ride-hailing, food delivery, utility payments, and more in cities across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Ethiopia, and India.
candidates.rationale: Both are super-apps offering ride-hailing, delivery, and payments across emerging markets, targeting similar consumers and merchants.

candidates.name: Rikaab
candidates.description: Rikaab is building the future of urban transport by connecting passengers and drivers at the tap of a button, making travel easier, safer, and more accessible.
candidates.rationale: Rikaab appears to be a smaller ride-hailing transport service, not a Southeast Asian super-app with delivery, payments, and financial services.

candidates.name: SafeBoda
candidates.description: SafeBoda is a leading technology-driven transportation and fintech company revolutionizing mobility in Uganda and Kenya. Since its founding in 2014, SafeBoda has been committed to providing safe, reliable, and affordable transportation solutions through its innovative mobile application. With a trusted network of trained and certified boda boda riders and car drivers, SafeBoda enhances urban mobility while empowering communities with digital financial services. Beyond transportation, the platform offers seamless payment solutions, fintech services, and on-demand deliveries, making everyday transactions faster and more convenient.
candidates.rationale: Same super-app model: ride-hailing, delivery, and fintech for consumers/merchants in comparable emerging-market geography.

candidates.name: Appscrip
candidates.description: Appscrip is a global technology provider for startups and enterprises. We provide cutting-edge software solutions to companies looking to scale their businesses. With a strong in-house team of 200+ tech experts and engineers, we have built a series of ready-to-use software for companies planning to establish on-demand services, social e-commerce, health tech, logistics, and messaging platforms. We have made headlines for our work with high-flying brands such as Reliance Jio (JioMart), Siemens, Al Jazeera, Glance, and Inmobi. We have also built great products for well-funded startups such as Rapido, Hugo, Yummy Rocket, Pronto, and many more. We've earned awards and recognition from the likes of Deloitte, Clutch, and Goodfirms, as well as developed long-term business relations with major industry leaders like Foretees LLC, Deutsche Bank, Tata Steel, and others. We are a group of business and technology experts who have come together to take on the technological challenges that are restricting promising businesses from flourishing.
candidates.rationale: Appscrip is an IT services/software vendor serving startups and enterprises, not a super-app or direct lookalike of Grab.

candidates.name: Quqo
candidates.description: Quqo is a tech-enabled B2B platform that is digitizing the traditional trade channel in Southeast Asia's emerging market by offering traditional retailers, distributors, brands and manufacturers in the FMCG, healthcare and automotive aftermarket sectors an integrated suite of digital products and services.
candidates.rationale: Different model: Grab is a consumer super-app; Quqo is a B2B trade digitization platform for retailers and distributors.

candidates.name: Easychaw
candidates.description: Easychaw is a food service company. We are committed to making food service and delivery seamless for our users through a cash flow system where everyone can benefit. We offer a broad range of services for food consumers, merchants and delivery agents. Consumers 1. Find your favourite restaurant 2. Access menu of different restaurants. 3. Enjoy exciting promos 4. Place and track orders from the comfort of your home 5. Get food delivered to your doorstep hot and fast For Food Merchants and Courier Agents 1. Building a wider customer base 2. Earn more 3. Track your earnings 4. Benefit from our partner incentives
candidates.rationale: Food delivery marketplace in Nigeria; not comparable to Grab’s multi-service Southeast Asian super-app scale and scope.

candidates.name: Chat AND Pay World
candidates.description: We are a technology service provider empowering Telecom companies, Exchanges, and Governments with a Superapp Infrastructure that enables new monetization strategies and a first-mover advantage into the booming digital payments space.
candidates.rationale: B2B superapp infrastructure vendor, not a consumer super-app like Grab; serves telecoms/governments rather than Grab’s end customers.

candidates.name: Iot
candidates.description: Công ty cổ phần đầu tư IOT là một trong những công ty có bề dày kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực tư vấn, thiết kế, cung cấp, lắp đặt, sửa chữa, bảo hành, bảo trì … các loại màn hình, tivi thông minh, máy chiếu, màn chiếu, hệ thống trang âm, hội thảo, bảng điện tử thông minh cho các phòng học, giảng đường, hội trường của các nhà trường, cơ quan, doanh nghiệp, khu công nghiệp... Hiện nay chúng tôi đang là đại lý phân phối trực tiếp của các hãng sản xuất thiết bị hàng đầu thế giới.
candidates.rationale: Electronics distributor and AV installer, not a super-app, platform, or financial services company like Grab.

candidates.name: Gojek
candidates.description: Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and a pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem model, providing access to a wide range of services including transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. Gojek is founded on the principle of leveraging technology to remove life's daily frictions by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market. The company was first established in 2010 focusing on courier and motorcycle ride-hailing services, before launching its app in January 2015 in Indonesia. Since then, Gojek has grown to become the leading on-demand platform in Indonesia, with additional operations in Vietnam and Singapore. The Gojek platform now comprises over 2.5 million driver partners across the region. Gojek is part of the GoTo Group, the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia, consisting of Gojek, Tokopedia and GoTo Financial. Gojek is dedicated to solving the daily challenges faced by consumers, while improving the quality of life for millions of people across Southeast Asia, especially those in the informal sector and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs). The Gojek application is available for download via iOS and Android. .................... *IMPORTANT* Gojek is affiliated to the GoTo Group companies, and all authentic jobs/open positions listed by Gojek can ONLY be accessed via our official channels -- Gojek on LinkedIn, Gojek Tech on LinkedIn, Gojek on Glassdoor, and https://www.gojek.io/careers. In case you are contacted by our Talent Acquisition team, please ensure that the communication is coming from a valid Gojek domain - *****@gojek.com. If you are contacted by any third party outside of the authenticated channels highlighted above, please write to us at ethics@gotocompany.com to validate the job/open position. This is to avoid any potential instances of fraud, and to ensure your safety and security during the job application process.
candidates.rationale: Direct Southeast Asian super-app peer with overlapping ride-hailing, delivery, payments, and merchant services; same buyer personas and market.
